title: [Bug] /usage command fails to recognize active Max subscription
body:
**Bug Description**
## Bug: /usage shows "only available for subscription plans" despite having active Max subscription

**Environment:**
- Claude Code version: 2.0.76
- Platform: macOS
- Model: Opus 4.5
- Subscription: Max plan (180 EUR/month)

**Problem:**
The /usage command returns: "/usage is only available for subscription plans."

However, I have an active Max subscription (confirmed at claude.ai/settings/billing - shows "Max plan" with valid payment and invoices).

**Timeline:**
- Today (January 7, 2026) around 14:00 CET: /usage was working correctly
- Today around 18:30 CET: /usage stopped working with the above error
- No changes were made to my environment between these times

**Verified:**
- No ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable set
- OAuth credentials exist in Keychain ("Claude Code-credentials")
- ~/.claude.json shows correct oauthAccount with my email
- Logged out and back in - problem persists
- Same issue in both terminal Claude Code and Desktop app

**Related GitHub issue:** #11915

This appears to be a server-side authentication/recognition issue where Claude Code intermittently fails to recognize Max subscriptions.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: vscode
- Version: 2.0.76
- Feedback ID: c2bf8e29-f91e-4ea3-9d7d-e57606c86bd6

**Errors**
```json
[{"error":"Error: NON-FATAL: Lock acquisition failed for /Users/lohonyaigyozo/.local/share/claude/versions/2.0.76 (expected in multi-process scenarios)\n    at XZR (/$bunfs/root/claude:2430:2165)\n    at fUA (/$bunfs/root/claude:2430:1885)\n    at processTicksAndRejections (native:7:39)","timestamp":"2026-01-07T18:10:44.895Z"}]
```
author: LohiSoftsro
